concepts.section: Domain model — what the artifacts operate on
rows: The explicit graph of steps realising a use case. Deterministic by construction: no agent decides which steps exist or their order
A node in the graph, and the unit at which determinism, type, exposure and influence are assigned. Tool invocation is an attribute of a step, not a separate unit
A directed edge carrying a data class. Exposure and influence aggregate along edges, not by counting steps
How bad it is when the step works — effect class × reversibility × blast radius. Excludes likelihood
How bad it is when the step is wrong — derived along data flow to the effects it determines, attenuated only at D0-evaluable gates
A required outcome of the workflow, monitored independently of the steps that produce it. The only control that reaches suppression
Trigger predicate · obligation · enforcement point · evidence artifact · failure mode
